name: Handles, Finishing & Defense
summary: Get low with the ball, finish with your off hand, push the ball to the sideline on defense, then finish tired with full-court layups.

drills.name: Kneeling Dribble Series
drills.summary: Dribble from one knee to stay low and build quick, strong hands.
steps: Kneel on your left knee with the ball in your right hand.
Pound 20 hard dribbles at your side, then 20 front to back.
Cross the ball under your raised knee and back 10 times.
Switch knees and hands and repeat the series.
Finish with 20 fast crossovers in front of your body.

drills.name: Off-Hand Wing Layups
drills.summary: Attack from both wings and finish with your weaker hand every time.
steps: Start on the right wing, one step outside the three-point line.
Drive with your off hand and finish with the same off hand.
Rebound, dribble out to the left wing and repeat.
Make 10 in a row before you switch to the reverse side of the rim.
Keep a count of your misses and beat it next time.

drills.name: Cone Funnel Slides
drills.summary: Cut off the middle and push the ball toward the sideline.
steps: Set two cones at the top of the key and two near the sideline at the baseline.
Start in stance at the top cone, nose on the inside shoulder of an imaginary ball handler.
Slide on a diagonal toward the sideline cone, staying between the ball and the middle.
At the cone, drop your outside foot and sit low like you just stopped the ball.
Jog back and repeat from the other top cone toward the other side.

drills.name: Layup-to-Line Burnouts
drills.summary: Sprint to the rim, finish, and run back to the far line while tired.
steps: Start at half court with the ball.
Speed dribble in and make a right-hand layup.
Grab the rebound and sprint the ball back to half court.
Go again and make a left-hand layup.
Keep going for 40 seconds, then walk 20 seconds. Repeat 4 times.
Count your makes each round and try to match it.
